label: heart-s8
resisted: Nothing resisted coverage. Six inputs (age, exang:0, exang:1, oldpeak, slope:1, cp:4) split by hand (not flagged by tools). The age/no-angina/cp:4 chain is real but small (AUC -0.002, logit SD 0.34); its 'damping correction' hypothesis rests on weight signs and subgroup means. First root (structural 0.784) undone and re-annotated with 8 unconnected inputs as entries.
tool_bugs: get_viz_summary rejects 'line_plot' (valid 'line'). activation_profile needs node_id. get_formula shows output ReLU; compute_performance applies sigmoid. compute_shap >2 min. Tool compositional_coverage always 1.0.
summary: Mostly logistic regression: 16 direct edges (logit SD 3.9) plus two additive nonlinear readouts. Main: an exertional-ischaemia hinge 855 = ReLU(trestbps, oldpeak, exang:1 up; cp:1, slope:1 down) with clipped complement 1501 - flat below threshold, steep above (train AUC 0.947 -> 0.926 without it). Minor serial chain age -> 1669 (no exertional angina) -> 3353 (+cp:4), read out -0.515, tempering cp:4 and making age protective for older patients without exertional angina (AUC -0.002). Linear-only 0.924/0.851 vs full 0.947/0.897.
